newsitem.title: UK: Legal & General leads sector lower.
newsitem.headline: Legal & General leads sector lower.

text.p: Shares in UK life assurance companies tumbled on profit-taking on Thursday, leading the broad market lower.
At 1324 GMT, shares in Legal & General Group Plc were off 14-1/2p to 393-1/2, while shares in Prudential Corp shed 10p to 559-1/2. Shares in Sun Life & Provincial Holdings Plc eased 8p to 286-1/2.
"We're seeing profit-taking in all the financials from the banks right down to the insurers," said one market maker.

He said there was some evidence that investors were taking profits in the financial sectors, which have performed well in recent months, and buying shares that have underperformed, like food retailers.
